You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0277.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

PY

cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np

coords = [(261,226),(211,115),(93,103),(22,200),(71,310),(190,321),(260,424),(374,381),(374,260),(478,203),(582,261),(569,382),(478,434),(477,485),(616,405),(313,161),(362,51),(478,88),(582,22),(686,82),(686,202)]
# graph read from the drawing
rw=Chem.RWMol()
for i in range(21):
    a=Chem.Atom('N' if i in (6,17) else 'C')
    if i<6: a.SetIsAromatic(True)
    rw.AddAtom(a)
for i in range(6): rw.AddBond(i,(i+1)%6,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC)
edges=[(5,6),(6,7),(7,8),(8,0), (8,9),(9,10),(10,11),(11,12),(12,7), (7,13),(13,14),(14,10), (8,15),(15,16),(16,17),(17,9), (17,18),(18,19),(19,20),(20,10)]
for a,b in edges: rw.AddBond(a,b,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
m=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
# A right-handed coordinate model of the depicted projection: z toward viewer.
conf=Chem.Conformer(21)
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(coords):
    z=150 if i in (11,12,15,17) else -150 if i in (13,14) else 0
    conf.SetAtomPosition(i,(x/100,-y/100,z/100))
conf.Set3D(True);m.AddConformer(conf)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(m)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
    if a.GetIdx() not in [7,8,9,10]: a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('isomeric SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
print('chiral centers',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m,includeUnassigned=True))
print('formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
m.RemoveAllConformers(); mh=Chem.AddHs(m)
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=277;p.numThreads=0;p.maxIterations=2000
cs=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mh,numConfs=100,params=p)
print('Embedded',len(cs))
if len(cs)==0: raise RuntimeError('embedding failed')
results=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mh,numThreads=0,maxIters=3000)
ranked=sorted(zip(cs,results),key=lambda x:x[1][1])
print('lowest energies',ranked[:10])
best=ranked[0][0]
Chem.MolToMolFile(mh,'structure.mol',confId=best)
Chem.MolToXYZFile(mh,'answer.xyz',confId=best)
# Confirm geometry stereochemistry is the intended one.
check=Chem.Mol(mh)
for a in check.GetAtoms(): a.SetChiralTag(Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED)
Chem.AssignAtomChiralTagsFromStructure(check,confId=best,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(check,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('Geometry centers',[(i,check.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for i in (7,8,9,10)])
print('xyz atoms',mh.GetNumAtoms())
PY
python build.py

python - <<'PY'
p='build.py'
s=open(p).read().replace("print('Geometry centers',[(i,check.GetAtomWithIdx(i).GetProp('_CIPCode')) for i in (7,8,9,10)])", "print('Geometry centers',Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(check,includeUnassigned=True))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python build.py
head -7 answer.xyz
ls -l answer.xyz

python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('answer.xyz')
lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
lines[1]='3D structure from mol_0277.png; explicit hydrogens; coordinates in angstroms'
p.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
assert p.is_file() and len(lines)-2 == int(lines[0])
print('Confirmed answer.xyz exists with',lines[0],'atoms.')
PY
